question: Is a hospital trade association HOSPITAL_AFFILIATED_ENTITY or NONPROFIT_CBO under spec 8?
why_it_is_open: Spec 10.2 hospital-association row prescribes NONPROFIT_CBO, and that is what Alaska (Alaska Hospital & Healthcare Association, 4 awards) and Illinois (ICAHN) already use. Georgia hand-coded this row HOSPITAL_AFFILIATED_ENTITY in session 9, before that row existed, making it the outlier of three. Session 18 found the divergence and deliberately did not resolve it (re-coding a committed hand-coded row to satisfy a rule added the same day is how spec 2.1 regressions happen). Session 19 fixed the half that was a code defect -- HOSPITAL_AFFILIATED_ENTITY no longer short-circuits to DIRECT/Yes, so the shared classifier and Georgia now AGREE on the flow (IN_KIND_BENEFIT, distributed_to_hospital = No). What is left is purely the spec 8 typing question, which is a human call: it decides how the NEXT state codes an association, and Georgia is the only committed row it would touch.
dollar_effect: $0. The row carries no amount (Georgia publishes per initiative, not per recipient) and is distributed_to_hospital = No under either type, so neither bucket of rhtp_hospital_dollar_partition() moves whichever way it is settled. Decide it on the spec, not on the total.

question: Does the Michigan Health & Hospital Association's $8,625,000 reach member hospitals, and is it therefore spec 10.2's PASS_THROUGH_DESIGNATED + Yes rather than PASS_THROUGH_UNRESOLVED + Unclear?
options: PASS_THROUGH_DESIGNATED + Yes (spec 10.2's association row, if a source shows the money moves) | PASS_THROUGH_UNRESOLVED + Unclear (what this file publishes) | IN_KIND_BENEFIT + No (Alaska's AHHA and Georgia's GHA answer, if MHA delivers services rather than moving money)
why_it_is_open: MHA is Michigan's hospital trade association and holds the two largest RHTP awards in the state -- $6,000,000 under the Rural Health Care Delivery Hub and Spoke Model and $2,625,000 under the Collaborative Care Integration and Sustainability Fund. Spec 10.2's association row would make that distributed_to_hospital = Yes, but ONLY where the source shows the funds are administered to or on behalf of member hospitals, and NOTHING IN THE SOURCE SAYS EITHER WAY: MDHHS's roster has three columns and no project description at all, and MHA's own RHTP page says the Center of Rural Excellence 'supports innovative solutions that help rural hospitals meet the evolving needs of their patients and communities', which is not a statement that money moves. Silence is evidence for a school district; it is not evidence here (session 19), so the rows take the terminal branch -- PASS_THROUGH_UNRESOLVED + Unclear + FLOW_UNRESOLVED_HOSPITAL_AFFILIATED -- and enter NEITHER bucket of rhtp_hospital_dollar_partition(). The two worked negatives in spec 10.2 are the reason this cannot be read off the organisation's name: the Georgia Hospital Association bought obstetrical emergency carts and the Alaska Hospital & Healthcare Association performed assessments naming three hospitals, and in both the carts and the assessments reached hospitals while the dollars did not. THE EVIDENCE THAT WOULD SETTLE IT IS A GRANT AGREEMENT OR SCOPE OF WORK, which MDHHS has not published. Note that this is NOT the open GHA_RECIPIENT_TYPE question, which is about spec 8 TYPING and is worth $0; this one moves $8,625,000.
dollar_effect: $8,625,000 -- 12.3% of everything Michigan has published, and 112 times Michigan's entire named-hospital figure of $76,924. It moves in one direction only: today those dollars are in neither bucket.
